t: What is Search Find Buy? And does it really work? - The PickFu blog
s: October 6, 2024 - All of those create the same result: someone buying your product. That is the main thing Amazon cares about. So, if I search “kitchen knife” on Amazon and scroll through a few pages of options, and I buy an option on the third page of results, I am telling Amazon that the item I purchased is the most relevant for the keyword “kitchen knife.” This will help bump up that product’s rank.
